principles: Rehabilitation is not a morality bar.
Progress is multidimensional, non-linear and documented.
Participation without accountability is not success.
A relapse does not erase all progress, but changes risk and supervision.
Victim safety and consent are required for restorative contact.

accountability.description: Recognizes actions and impact without hiding behind motive.

empathy.description: Can represent victim experience without immediate self-defense.

skillTransfer.description: Uses abilities in safe, prosocial contexts.

networkStability.description: Has housing, work and relationships not dependent on crime.

restitution.description: Repairs harm where possible and consented.

autonomy.description: Makes prosocial choices without coercive supervision.

stageRules.entry: denies harm or sees no need to change
stageRules.advance: sustained recognition of personal cost and victim impact
chooses concrete goals and accepts monitoring
begins behavior change in controlled setting
sustained progress across at least four dimensions

weeklyProgressFormula: weighted dimension delta + attendance + verified repair - incidents - deception - trigger exposure without plan
antiGamingRules: High skillTransfer cannot compensate for zero accountability.
Mentor opinion must be accompanied by observed evidence.
Informant cooperation cannot automatically reduce rehabilitation requirements.
